evidence.snippet: Each user creates a personal API key in Linear under Settings > Security & access > Personal API keys and pastes it when connecting.
Create a new OAuth2 Application and configure the redirect callback URLs to your application.

decisions.reason: Developers can self-serve generate a free personal API key or create an OAuth2 application without payment or admin approval mentioned.

evidence.snippet: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model or agent to access your Linear data

decisions.reason: Linear's own docs page describes and hosts an official MCP server at https://mcp.linear.app/mcp.
